spans.s: शप् vt. or vi. 1U, 4U (pp. शप्त; pres. शपति-ते, शप्यति-ते) 1. To curse, to imprecate, न भविष्यति मत्प्रसूतिमनाराध्य प्रजेति त्वां शशाप सा R.i.77, अशपद्भव मानुषीति ताम् R.viii.80, ix.78; 2. to take an oath, to swear, to promise by oath, भावानुरक्तवनितासुरतैः शपेयम्
Ghat.22

; (in this sense, शप् sometimes governs a cognate accusative, e.g. नैतन्मतं मत्कमिति ब्रुवाणः सहस्रशोऽसौ शपथानशप्यत् Bt.iii.32; but generally it takes the accusative of the person to whom a promise is made, and the instrumental of the object by which it is made; when used intransitively it governs the dative of the object or person by which the oath is taken, प्रेमजिज्ञासमानाभ्यस्ताभ्योऽशप्सत Bt.viii.33; 3. to blame, (with a dat., e.g. कृष्णाय शपे).
सप् vt. 1P (pres. सपति) 1. To connect; 2. to worship.
शप m. 1. An imprecation, a curse; 2. an oath.
शाप m. 1. A curse, an anathema, निर्वीर्यं गुरुशापभाषितवशात् किं मे तवेवायुधम् Ve.iii., R.i.78, Megh.i.1; 2. oath, imprecatious; 3. abuse.
शपत्र n. 1. An imprecation, curse; 2. an oath; 3. abuse, abusive language.
शपथ m. 1. An imprecation, a curse; 2. an oath, an asseveration by oath or ordeal, M.viii.109; 3. conjuration.
शपन n. The same as शपथ q.v.
शप्त a. (f. प्ता) 1. Cursed; 2. sworn; 3. abused, (pp. of शप् q.v.).
शप्त a. (f. प्ता) 1. Cursed; 2. sworn; 3. abused, (pp. of शप् q.v.).
शाप-अंत m. the end of a curse, Megh.ii.37.
शाप-अवसान n. the end of a curse, Megh.ii.37.
शाप-अस्त्र m. a saint, a sage.
शाप-उत्सर्ग m. the uttering of an imprecation.
शाप-उद्धार m. deliverance from a curse.
शाप-मुक्त a. released from a curse.
शाप-यंत्रित a. restrained by a curse.

सपक्ष (I) a. (f. क्षा) 1. Having wings, winged; 2. having a side or party; 3. belonging to the same party; 4. like, similar, दलद्द्राक्षानिर्यद्रसभरसपक्षा भणितयः Bh.V.ii.77; 5. containing the major term or subject.
सपक्ष (II) m. 1. A partisan, a follower, an adherent; 2. an instance on the same side, a similar instance (in logic).

सपक्ष (I) a. (f. क्षा) 1. Having wings, winged; 2. having a side or party; 3. belonging to the same party; 4. like, similar, दलद्द्राक्षानिर्यद्रसभरसपक्षा भणितयः Bh.V.ii.77; 5. containing the major term or subject.
सपत्न m. An enemy, adversary, rival.
सापत्न (I) a. (f. त्नी) Born from a rival wife.
सापत्न (II) m. pl. The children of the different wives of the same husband.
सपत्नी f. A woman who has the same husband with another, a co-wife, a rival mistress, भूत्वा चिराय चतुरंतमहीसपत्नी Sak.iv.
सापत्न (I) a. (f. त्नी) Born from a rival wife.
सपत्नीक a. (f. का) Accompanied with a wife.
सपत्नीक a. (f. का) Accompanied with a wife.
सपत्राकरण n. Wounding so that the feathered part of the arrow enters the body. Cf. निष्पत्राकरण.
सपत्राकृति f. Great agony or affliction, excessive pain.
सपदि ind. Instantly, immediately, कुमारसैन्यं सपदि स्थितं च तत् R.iii.40, K.S.iii.76.
सपर्या f. Worship, प्रतिविहितसपर्यासुस्थयोस्तान्यहानि Ut.i.
सपाद a. (f. दा) Having a fourth part, increased by one-fourth.
सपाद a. (f. दा) Having a fourth part, increased by one-fourth.

सपिंड m. (having the same piṇḍa or ‘funeral cake’) A kinsman connected by the offering of the funeral cake to the Manes of certain relations, or according to some by blood, गुरुदारे सपिंडे वा गुरुवद्वृत्तिमाचरेत् M.ii.247.

सपिंडी f. The Śrāddha in honour of the deceased relatives called sapiṇḍa (to be performed at the end of a full year after the death of a relative; but now generally performed on the twelfth day after death).
सपीति f. Drinking together, drinking in company.
सप्तक (I) a. (f. का or की) 1. Containing seven; 2. seventh; 3. seven.
सप्तक (II) n. A collection of seven things.
सप्तक (I) a. (f. का or की) 1. Containing seven; 2. seventh; 3. seven.
सप्तक (I) a. (f. का or की) 1. Containing seven; 2. seventh; 3. seven.
सप्तकी f. A woman’s girdle.
सप्तति f. Seventy.
सप्तति-तम a. the 70th.
सप्तन् num. (always pl.; nom. and acc. सप्त) Seven.
सप्तन्-अर्चिस् m. 1. fire (supposed to have seven distinct flames or tongues); 2. fierce eyed.
सप्तन्-अशीति f. eighty-seven.
सप्तन्-अश्व m. the sun.
सप्तन्-अश्व˚वाहन m. the sun.
सप्तन्-आत्मन् m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
सप्तन्-अह n. seven days, i.e. a week.
सप्तन्-ऋषि m. pl. 1. Ursa Major (the seven stars of which are supposed to be the seven great Ṛshis मरीचि, अत्रि, अंगिरस्, पुलस्त्य, पुलह, क्रतु and वसिष्ठ; 2. the seven sages themselves.
सप्तन्-चत्वारिंशत् f. forty-seven.
सप्तन्-जिह्व, -ज्वाल m. fire.
सप्तन्-जिह्व, -ज्वाल m. fire.
सप्तन्-त्रिंशत् f. thirty-seven.
सप्तन्-दशन् a. pl. seventeen.
सप्तन्-दीधिति m. an epithet of Agni.
सप्तन्-द्वीपा f. an epithet of the earth.
सप्तन्-धातु m. pl. the seven constituent elements of the body (namely chyle, blood, flesh, fat, bone, marrow and semen).
सप्तन्-नाडीचक्र n. an astrological diagram supposed to foretell rain.
सप्तन्-छद, -पत्र, -पर्ण m. name of a tree.
सप्तन्-छद, -पत्र, -पर्ण m. name of a tree.
सप्तन्-छद, -पत्र, -पर्ण m. name of a tree.
सप्तन्-पदी f. the ceremony of walking together round the nuptial fire.
सप्तन्-प्रकृति f. pl. the seven constituent parts of a kingdom, (viz., king, ministers, ally, territory, fortress, army and treasury).
सप्तन्-भद्र m. the śirīshā tree.
सप्तन्-भूमिक a. seven stories high.
सप्तन्-विध a. seven-fold.
सप्तन्-शती f. an aggregate of 700 verses.
सप्तन्-सप्ति m. an epithet of the sun, सर्वैरुस्रैः समग्रैस्त्वमिव नृप गुणैर्दीप्यते सप्तसप्तिः Mal.ii.
सप्तम a. (f. मी) The seventh.
सप्तम a. (f. मी) The seventh.
सप्तमी f. 1. The locative case (in gram.); 2. the seventh day of a lunar fortnight.
सप्तला f. A kind of jasmine.
सप्ति m. 1. A yoke; 2. a horse, e.g. जवो हि सप्तेः परमं विभूषणम्.
सापत्न्य (I) m. 1. An enemy; 2. the son of a rival wife.
सापत्न्य (II) n. 1. Ambition, rivalry; 2. the condition of a rival wife.
सापिंड्य n. Kindred, connection by the presentation of offerings or by blood to the same Manes.
साप्तपद (I) a. Effected by seven steps, मनीषीभिः साप्तपदीनमुच्यते (संगतं) K.S.v.39.
साप्तपद (I) a. Effected by seven steps, मनीषीभिः साप्तपदीनमुच्यते (संगतं) K.S.v.39.
साप्तपदीन (II) n. 1. Circumambulation of the nuptial fire by the bride and bridegroom in seven steps (after which the marriage is complete); 2. friendship.
साप्तपौरुष a. (f. षी) Comprising seven generations, M.iii.146.
साप्तपौरुष a. (f. षी) Comprising seven generations, M.iii.146.
